pc1xBig.allSet.subtitle.add: Add the Play gradient lightstrip to an existing Entertainment area or create a new one.
pc1xBig.allSet.subtitle.finish: After installation, please go to Settings > Entertainment areas to set up your Entertainment area!
pc1xBig.checkSize.subTitle:
Refer to your monitor's size for placement:
32 inch: 5 cm from the edge
34 inch: 6.5 cm from the edge

Is it larger? Place the mounts more toward the centre.
pc1xBig.checkSize.title: Before attaching the mounts
pc1xBig.checkUpdates.subtitle: Go to Settings > Software updates to check for updates.
pc1xBig.checkUpdates.title: Make sure your Hue Bridge and Hue Sync desktop app are up to date
pc1xBig.clean.tv.subtitle: Remove dust to make sure the mounts adhere to the monitor.
pc1xBig.clean.tv.title: Clean the monitor with a damp cloth
pc1xBig.getHelp.title: Tip: Invite a friend to help — it's easier with two people!
pc1xBig.install.align.subtitle: Make sure the arrow in the centre of the lightstrip is aligned with the centre of the monitor.
pc1xBig.install.align.title: Press the lightstrip gently into the mounts
pc1xBig.install.centerMount.subtitle:
Place two straight mounts onto the top of the monitor.

The arrows on the mounts should be pointing upwards.
pc1xBig.install.centerMount.title: Attach the top mounts
pc1xBig.install.connectPower.subtitle: The control box has an adhesive backing so you can attach it to your monitor. Make sure the control box is plugged in to the wall socket.
pc1xBig.install.connectPower.title: Plug the lightstrip's power cable into the control box
pc1xBig.install.cornerMounts.subtitle: The arrows on the mounts should be pointing outwards.
pc1xBig.install.cornerMounts.title: Peel the adhesive backing off the corner mounts and attach them to the backside of the monitor
pc1xBig.install.lowerMounts.title: Attach the lower mounts and insert the lightstrip
pc1xBig.makeSureCableUnplugged.title: Unplug the lightstrip power cable from the control box
pc1xBig.start.title: Let's attach the Hue Play gradient lightstrip to your monitor
